title: ArtELingo: A Million Emotion Annotations of WikiArt with Emphasis on Diversity over Language and Culture
findings: The emotional interpretation of religious symbols, such as the Christian cross, varies significantly across cultures. For example, an artwork depicting stomping on the devil while holding a cross was perceived positively (awe) in English and Arabic cultures but negatively (fear) in Chinese culture, where the symbol holds less meaning and the act of stomping is perceived as more scary.
